name: generic-two-arguments-use-and
why: Arity needs no explicit marker: the separators carry the structure. X<Y, Z> is X_of_Y_and_Z while X<Y<Z>> is X_of_Y_of_Z, so the two are distinguishable without encoding a count that every SDK would have to format identically.
subject: Acme.Pair_of_Acme.A_and_Acme.B
